model_annotations.Bulgarian: The line of scientific linear diagram serves to depict various approaches to accuracy across three subjects: MathVerse, MMLU, and Physics. The x-axis is categorized by subject name, while the y-axis denotes percentage accuracy. The first category, "MathVerse," consists of four different approaches to accuracy, namely DAPO, GRPO, SRPO, and DAPO+Self-reflection, with percentages ranging from the lowest at 52% to the highest at 58%. The second category, "MMLU," follows a similar pattern, with the lowest accuracy being slightly higher at 54% and the highest being close to 58%. The third category, "Physics," reflects a consistent pattern in accuracy, with the lowest at 52%, the highest at 62%, and DAPO+Self-reflection again leading to the highest percentage of accuracy at approximately 61%. The legend detailing the approaches to accuracy corresponds to each category, enabling clear identification of the methodology behind the depicted percentages.
model_annotations.Chinese: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of various AI models across three different subjects: Mathverse, MMMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy as a percentage, while the horizontal axis categorizes the data into the three subjects. There are six distinct bars for each subject, each representing a different AI model: DAPO with Reflection, GRPO, DRPO with Reflection, DRPO without Reflection, DRPO with Self-reflection, and DAPO without Reflection. The accuracy of the models ranges between approximately 52% and 62%, with noticeable differences in performance between the models. The graph utilizes solid lines for the data bars and includes numerical values along the accuracy axis. The categories are not ordered by value on the chart.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of different assessment methods across three fields: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis is labeled 'Accuracy (%)' and ranges from 50 to 62, with a linear scale. The horizontal axis represents the fields of Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, which are sorted alphabetically. There are six bars in total, each corresponding to a combination of a summative reasoning assessment method and self-reflection annotation. The assessment methods included are DAPO, GRPO, PPO, and SRPO. Each bar is color-coded based on the labeling in the legend at the top of the chart, and each bar is labeled with the specific assessment method it represents. The height of each bar corresponds to the accuracy percentage in the respective field. For instance, in the field of Mathverse, DAPO+Self-reflection has an accuracy of just under 55%, while SRPO has the highest accuracy in Physics, just over 60%. The chart does not provide any information about trends over time or comparisons between the fields.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm veranschaulicht den Vergleich der Genauigkeit aller fünf getesteten Ansätze in drei verschiedenen Kategorien: Mathverse, MMU, und Physics. Die horizontale Achse repräsentiert die Genauigkeit in Prozent, während die vertikale Achse die drei Kategorien darstellt. Die Balken sind geordnet von links nach rechts nach der Reihenfolge MATHVERSE, MMU und Physics. Jedes Diagrammsegment zeigt den prozentualen Wert des Rundfensters. DAPO zeigt auch Selbstreflexion-Modifikationen, wobei DAPO+Self-reflection und DAPO ohne solche Modifikation verglichen werden. SRPO enthält separate Werte. Die Philosophie-Systeme haben PPPO und PPO für jeden Kategorien, wobei beide ebenfalls Modifikationen wie PPPO+Self-reflection und PPPO offenbaren. Die Genauigkeitmaßstiche sind konsistent durchgehend durch Streifenvisualisierungen innerhalb der Balken dargestellt, wobei 62% die Höchstgenauigkeit und 50% die Mindestgenauigkeit darstellen.
